Filing-gate category: ② execution of a maintainer ruling. Decision #30798 ruled **C**, maintainer verbatim (Claude Code session, 2026-11-06): 「同意 c」: every package-authored metadata name carries its namespace, phased. Routing, verbatim: 「能交给车队开发的你不要自己开发」.

Phase 2 of 3, the AI-authoring half. Under C the AI writes one rule: every name starts with the package namespace. The published skills must teach it before phase 3 makes it a refusal.

## Ask

1. Update the published authoring skills under `skills/**` and their examples so every metadata name they show or generate carries the namespace prefix (`crm_send_email`, `crm_sales_rep`), stated as one rule beside the existing object rule. Exceptions: fields, object extensions, container views, translations.
2. Fix every example in those skills that shows a bare non-object name.
3. `skills/**` is a governed surface: land it through the governed path.
